title: Free World Knowledge Foundation / KNOWINDEX knowledge evidence crosswalk

ownership_and_scope.permission_policy: public metadata only; provenance and community consent required for individual works

knowindex.name: KNOWINDEX
knowindex.publication_state: methodology and crosswalk only; no issuer updates, broadcasts, issuance, transfers, or rights grants

measures.label: Registered knowledge
measures.definition: Distinct eligible resource IDs with works and editions reported separately

measures.label: Provenance coverage
measures.definition: Reviewed source and attribution evidence divided by eligible resources

measures.label: Permission coverage
measures.definition: Resources with documented authority divided by resources proposed for that access class

measures.label: Access reliability
measures.definition: Successful checks divided by attempted checks for permitted resources

measures.label: Preservation integrity
measures.definition: Preserved files passing current byte-hash verification divided by preserved files checked

measures.label: Community participation
measures.definition: Consented contributions and participating organizations, separately reported

measures.label: Learning and application
measures.definition: Separately verified course completions, citations, and applications

measures.label: Knowledge economy activity
measures.definition: Documented license events, paid research or teaching engagements and verified receipts; excludes market capitalization and projections

crown_chain_evidence.publishing_rule: No contributor data, claims of token rights, chain hashes or signing without consent, authorization and independent verification
